svg.title: PC-12 CONTROL YOKE - SECTIONS
svg.desc: PC12-L6Y2 rev B, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
CROWN TOP h 65.3, TOP LAND 2 x 0.8
insert top 6° further fwd, blend R 20 [M low / E]
BODY: 60 DEEP [E], ITS TOP A PLANE 42° FROM THE HORIZONTAL THROUGH THE TOP LINE (h 60.5 AT u 0)
forward edges R 8, top-to-front R 8, foot R 14 [E]; black body and grips one moulding
PLANE u 0 (CUTTING PLANE Z-Z ON L6Y FRONT ELEVATION)
YOKE CENTRELINE u 0, FROM OUTBOARD, NOSE LEFT - 2:1
the arm's top edge, C1 chamfer
THROUGH (52, 45) NORMAL TO THE ARM (30° UP OUTBOARD), LOOKING INBOARD (L6Y FRONT ELEVATION) - 2:1
OUTBOARD GRIP, NORMAL TO THE AXIS, LOOKING DOWN IT (FWD UP, PAD DOWN; OUTBOARD LEFT)
INBOARD GRIP, NORMAL TO THE AXIS, LOOKING DOWN IT (FWD UP, PAD DOWN; INBOARD RIGHT)
PAD: leather 2.5 below the 2 frame, crowned to 0.5 below over 8; groove 1 x 0.5 + bead 0.4; frame roll R 1.5; forward R 11 [E] <= 0.45 x half-width; depth PCHIP (grip_depth) [M low]
leather 2.5 below the frame, crowned to 0.5 over 8
AXIAL PLANES (AXIS + AFT NORMAL), FWD LEFT
OUTBOARD GRIP, ON P-P, AFT RIGHT - 3:1
grey: the black moulding seen along the face normal (exact silhouette, clipped +/-21);
nothing of it stands above the face: max 0.00 mm (yoke_checks)
SADDLE (EXPONENT 1.6) [E +/-2], TOP EDGES R 0.5, RING FLUSH
VIEW NORMAL TO THE ROUND FACE (38° UP) - 2:1
VIEW NORMAL TO THE SHIELD FACET - 2:1
HEX 15 A/F, CAP 10.2, TOP R 1, DIMPLE 2 x 0.4 [E]
BUTTON: EXACT CUT ALONG THE FACET NORMAL - 3:1
bezel 1 proud, dish r 4.8-8.7 0.8 deep [E]; button dome 1.2, its top 2 ABOVE the bezel [M low]
u 58.5 h 51.4 ON THE WHITE ARM; PROFILE = EXACT CUT - 3:1
boss 1.5 proud of the body [E], 8 deep: its back free over the hand slot; edge R 0.8, cap top R 1
u 60.6 h 23.4; BOSS = A SOLID OF THE MOULDING; PROFILE = EXACT CUT - 3:1
PLAIN FIELD (NO LETTERING); GROOVES 0.5 x 0.3 CUT IN THE INSERT
ABSTRACT WINGED PLATE, TOP AT h 53.2 - 2:1
J BAND 8 PROUD OF THE RECESS FLOOR
PHANTOM: FULL PUSH -90 [E], leaves 17 to the panel
AT THE LOWER PANEL, FROM OUTBOARD - 1:2
the band's arc curves under the stem [E]
phantom: the shell; hidden: the column dia 44
PHOTO CHECK (rev K): THE DRAWN SOLIDS RAY-CAST THROUGH THE PHOTO CAMERAS (mm, + = drawn wider)
AOPA press, pilot (15 deg from outboard)
GRIP SIDES PER BAND OF h: SIGNED MAX mm (h -50..-30 | -30..-10 | -10..10 | 10..30)

GRIP PLANES (judges FID2-01): rake / toe / a0 / wall direction fitted per grip to these curated rows and the pad traces of all 7 views (the grip prism, defined in its plane coordinates, re-mapped exactly for each plane). The 5 views

from inboard (P1046408 L / R, P1046410, Mexico L / R: 23-27° off aft, Mexico 15-20° from above) give outboard 19.3° / 19.4° / -3.7 / 0.61, inboard 20.5° / 18.4° / -4.9 / 0.03 -- the table's 20 / 18 / -3.75 / 0.6, 0 kept; their cost rises

10 % at rake +/-3° (out) / +/-5° (in), a0 +/-3 / +/-5. With the AOPA views the fit moves < 1.5° / 2.5 and the 7-view cost drops only 7 / 3 %: no plane the 5 views allow meets the AOPA residuals (co-pilot: outboard outer edge -9..-16

below h 0, inboard slot -10..-12, inboard pad 9; pilot: pads 5.6 / 2.9) -- the same view puts the inboard button 13 off (6 views within 1-2) and its pose is degenerate along the line of sight: reported, not fitted (L6Y open point 2).

INBOARD NECK (criterion, P1046408): the drawn moulding's top edge vs the photo per pixel column, arm tip to head -- pilot mean -0.6, |mean| 2.3, max -6.9 mm (against the red placard; rev I 'neck in' 14.2 / 20.7); co-pilot -4.5,
max -7.5 (drawn LOW near the head; against the dark PFD, low contrast).

Pose per photo fitted to the COVER landmarks only (TCS, AFCS, badge, step ends, lower-insert corners, foot; the AOPA co-pilot view with its step / insert picks); heads, grips, pads, neck and shell are checks. Grip rows: the

CURATED photo silhouettes -- auto edges per image row in the near views with the panel recesses masked, the inboard slot sides hand-traced and snapped past the J band / panel seam, the AOPA co-pilot sides hand-traced;

the AOPA pilot auto rows dropped (they lock onto the leather on the dark panel) -- against the ray-cast grip's own hits (part-labelled), per image row, h on the grip axis. Overlays: refs/cache/overlays/yoke (private).
CORNERS & RADII (every other sample is on a C1 spline)
perimeter R 1; arm lower R 2; foot underside R 3; tip facet corners R 2
frame roll R 1.5; forward R 11 [E] capped at 0.45 x the inscribed half-width; heel R 4; trim face R 1.5; pad step crisp, groove 1 x 0.5, bead 0.4
aft R 2; forward R 8 [E]; top-to-front R 8 [E]; foot R 14 [E]; neck-to-head blend R 3; AFCS boss R 0.8, blend R 1.5
crown soft break R 20; top land C1 chamfer 2 x 0.8; TCS seat 1.5 deep

CURVE LAW: centripetal Catmull-Rom (alpha 0.5) through the table samples, 0.25 sampling; corners as listed (R 0 sharp, R > 0 tangent fillet); YOKE_DESIGN curve_law; the solids use the EXACT distance to these

ACCEPTANCE (model/yoke_checks.py, judges DR2-01..04): fields: zero level vs the curve-law polylines, max shell 0.0358, grip_out 0.0320, grip_in 0.0342, pad_out 0.0312, pad_in 0.0223, body 0.0257 mm; nothing above

the trim face: max 0.00 mm; above the shield facet: max 0.00 mm; untabled cusps (> 25 deg within +-0.15 mm): grip_out 0 / 41 sections, grip_in 0 / 39 sections, Z-Z 0, K-K 0; vertex normals vs analytic (0.25 mm depth-map
mesh, 95th / 99th / max deg): cover stem / inserts 0.00 / 0.06 / 21.2; cover arm + TCS 0.29 / 1.13 / 7.3; outboard grip pad / frame 0.51 / 1.53 / 29.3; inboard grip pad / frame 0.49 / 1.75 / 4.3.

SECTIONS: exact contours of the solids (model/yoke_geom.py) on the cutting planes; the black body and the grips are one moulding (smooth union R 3), the white cover a separate part; hatching per part.
Sources per value: the [M] / [E] / [S] tags of YOKE_DESIGN (printed in model/interior.py).

first issue with L6Y rev B (judges r1 D1 / D2 / D5 / D10, FID1-04..06 / 09..12): exact sections of the rev J solids -- centreline, arm, 8 grip sections, the grips' axial profiles with the heel lip; the round trim face
and the shield facet; switch profiles; the column surround in front view; corner / radius table; photo check per grip row and the inboard neck

rev K (judges r2): exact-field solids; Z-Z / K-K dimensioned with ordinates; grip sections free of untabled cusps (forward R capped, PCHIP depth); pad groove + bead and heel lip R 4 built (details S, P);

detail F from the solid (the web held under the face); D / E / G profiles exact cuts of the TCS (button proud), AFCS boss + cap and button solids; section J-J of the column band; acceptance checks; photo
check on curated silhouettes incl. the AOPA co-pilot view, part-labelled ray-cast, per-band maxima; grip planes joint-fitted to 7 views (the table confirmed by 5, the AOPA photo open)
